name: gpt-prompt-builder
description: Builds copy-paste "Reasoning Scaffold" prompts for any task. Produces ready-to-run prompts with verification, privacy checks, and optional execution. Inspired by Section School, Ethan Mollick & Charles Duhigg.

defaultPrompt: ASSISTANT: Create a reusable prompt to triage my inbox and draft replies in my voice.
CREATOR: Give me a prompt to outline and draft a 600-word blog post on [topic] in [brand voice].
STRATEGIST: Produce a prompt to compare 3 options against criteria and recommend one.
